movement._todo: OQ-18: jump itself is decided (jump_enabled true); all movement numbers are still placeholders
movement.base_speed_note: Shibi Oct 22 asked for +5-10%; +7.5% chosen (5.0 x 1.075). base_speed_mps stays a placeholder.
movement.base_speed_g3b_note: G3b-1 Oct 23 2026: run 4.7 m/s, sprint 6.3 m/s (x1.34), MEASURED (PC), community sources pubg.fandom.com/wiki/Movement_Speed and samurai-gamers; community-measured, not official. The Japanese samurai-gamers page measures sprint at 6.2 m/s (known variance). Supersedes base_speed_note. Still a placeholder.

weapon_speed_penalty.note: placeholder multiplier on run speed while holding a weapon; 1.0 = no penalty; not wired yet (OQ-WEAPON-SPEED)

ground_accel.note: seconds from rest to full speed; 0 = instant. 4.7 m/s / 40 m/s^2 keeps the ground acceleration at exactly 40 m/s^2

ground_decel.note: seconds from full speed to stop; 0 = instant. 4.7 m/s / 40 m/s^2 keeps the ground deceleration at exactly 40 m/s^2

sprint_speed_multiplier.note: our placeholder starting value, no sourced number

sprint_ramp_s.unit: seconds to ease between run speed and sprint speed, both directions

strafe_back_ratio._source: TSG Forge Wiki community tag data: sideways 2 / forward 2.25, backward 2
strafe_back_ratio.note: sideways and backward speed as a ratio of forward speed

melee._todo: OQ-56 (DECIDED Oct 22 2026: Gladius Lux follows the DESIGN.md:15 melee rule). Only the entries listed in _placeholders are placeholders.
melee._back_angle_note: PLACEHOLDER (OQ-56): a hit is from behind when the angle between the target's facing and the direction target->attacker is greater than this.
melee.front_hit_no_shield_rule: PLACEHOLDER (OQ-56), not a Shibi decision: the 70%-of-full-shield amount is applied to health through the normal shield-then-health path.
melee.gladiator_front_hit_no_shield_rule: PLACEHOLDER (OQ-56 item 3), not a Shibi decision: with a Gladiator attacker, a front hit on a target with no shield left takes the full max_shield amount off health.

aim._todo: OQ-AIM (GBTN): tapping Aim zooms the camera and tightens spread; the zoom stays on after release until Aim is tapped again (pure tap toggle, aim_toggle_enabled true = Shibi pick 1.1, Fold eye-test 2026-10-28; false = hold-to-aim). No weapon has its own aim spread in the data yet, so one global multiplier applies. aim_fov_mult, aim_zoom_s and aim_spread_mult are placeholders: not PUBG values, not design values. aim_hold_threshold_s: unused since pure tap toggle (kept for data shape).

_weapons_comment: Starter set, see docs/STATS.md. Shibi tunes these on the phone. Shibi Fold eye-test 2026-10-28: reload times halved (pilum_br 2.0 -> 1.0, sagittarii_rifle 2.5 -> 1.25; still placeholders, OQ-06). Kinds: hitscan (burst/single, uses magazine) and melee (swing: melee_range_m, melee_arc_deg; no ammo).
